definitions.explanation: The joint connecting the upper arm and the forearm. The anatomical term for the elbow as a joint, used in medicine, sports, and physical therapy.

examples.japanese: {肘関節|ひじかんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げる→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧。
⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧{肘関節|ひじかんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}めた→痛める：13613_itameru⟧。
examples.english: I fell and hurt my elbow joint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{投球|とうきゅう}→投球：15510_toukyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肘関節|ひじかんせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Repeated pitching puts a strain on the elbow joint.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{肘|ひじ}→肘：00938_hiji⟧ (elbow) + ⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧ (joint). The technical term for the elbow joint, common in medical and sports contexts; in everyday speech people simply say ⟦{肘|ひじ}→肘：00938_hiji⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肘関節|ひじかんせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可動域|かどういき}: range of motion of the elbow joint
- {肘関節|ひじかんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}める→痛める：13613_itameru⟧: to injure the elbow joint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肘|ひじ}→肘：00938_hiji⟧: elbow — the everyday word for the body part
- ⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧: joint — the general term for any joint in the body
